plan_point: 77.44 / WEB-011 -> 77.44.7.D / EDT-042 adjacent diagnostics security regression
defect: Preboot ErrorEvent handling stored and logged untrusted raw messages, source URL queries and raw Error objects before the diagnostics module initialized, allowing credentials, private URL parameters and personal data into early diagnostics.

implementation.redaction: Preboot text is bounded and redacts bearer/token-like values, query secrets, email, phone and control characters; source URLs retain only a bounded path and redact the query.
implementation.raw_error_retention: The early queue stores only normalized source/code/message/file/line/column fields. Raw Error objects and target objects are not retained or logged.
implementation.bounded_queue: At most 100 early errors are retained; each message is capped at 320 characters.
implementation.hostile_values: Error field reads and string conversion are guarded so hostile getters/coercions cannot interrupt recovery.
implementation.save_publish: No changes to page data, Save, Publish, preview, API, D1 or R2 behavior. Save remains separate from Publish.
